body:
## Pull request overview

This PR delivers comprehensive documentation evaluating ObjectUI's component ecosystem for ObjectStack protocol implementation, establishing a strategic 2026 roadmap with a critical architectural clarification: **the dual component system architecture** (Platform Basic Components + Object Components). All 6 documentation files (2,369 lines) are provided in English for international accessibility and strictly adhere to the ObjectStack protocol specification.

**Changes:**
- Comprehensive component evaluation documenting 76 implemented Platform Basic Components with detailed protocol support matrix
- Strategic 2026 quarterly roadmap defining Object Component development (Q2 2026 target: 10 new components)
- Component naming conventions establishing `object-` prefix standard (instead of `os-`) for Object Protocol components
- Architecture documentation clarifying three-layer model and dual component system relationships

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| docs/README.md | Added navigation links to 6 new evaluation and planning documents |
| docs/OBJECTSTACK_COMPONENT_EVALUATION_EN.md | Executive summary in English covering component inventory, architecture, protocol support, and roadmap |
| docs/OBJECTSTACK_COMPONENT_EVALUATION.md | Complete Chinese evaluation report (893 lines) with dual system architecture details |
| docs/EVALUATION_INDEX.md | Navigation hub providing quick access to all evaluation documents with metrics and roadmap summary |
| docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP_2026.md | Detailed quarterly roadmap (760 lines) with sprint breakdowns and success metrics |
| docs/COMPONENT_NAMING_CONVENTIONS.md | Naming conventions document (476 lines) establishing `object-` prefix standard |
| docs/COMPONENT_MAPPING_GUIDE.md | Chinese component mapping guide comparing ObjectUI renderers with Shadcn components |
</details>

The document references indicate this is Chinese content, but the PR description emphasizes "All documentation provided in English for international accessibility." This creates confusion about whether Chinese content should be documented in this English-focused README. Consider either removing the Chinese notation or clarifying the multi-language documentation strategy in the PR description.
```suggestion
Note: Some evaluation and planning documents are currently only available in Chinese; English summaries are provided where available.
- 📊 [Component Evaluation Report](./OBJECTSTACK_COMPONENT_EVALUATION.md) - Full evaluation report (Chinese)
- 📊 [Component Evaluation – English Summary](./OBJECTSTACK_COMPONENT_EVALUATION_EN.md) - Executive summary in English
- 🗺️ [2026 Roadmap](./DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP_2026.md) - Detailed 2026 development roadmap (Chinese)
```

The link description indicates Chinese content "(中文)" but the actual DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP_2026.md file is in English. This mismatch between the description and actual content could confuse users. The description should accurately reflect the language of the linked document.
```suggestion
- 🗺️ [2026 Roadmap (English)](./DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP_2026.md) - Detailed 2026 development roadmap
```

Corrected capitalization of 'Bulk Edit Dialog' to maintain consistency with title case formatting used throughout the document.
```suggestion
| **Bulk Edit dialog** | 🔴 High | Batch edit multiple records | 3 days |
```

The document title is in Chinese (组件对照表 means "Component Mapping Table"), which contradicts the PR's emphasis on "All documentation provided in English for international accessibility." The entire COMPONENT_MAPPING_GUIDE.md appears to be in Chinese despite being listed as an English documentation deliverable.
```suggestion
# ObjectUI vs Shadcn: Component Mapping Table

**Quick reference**: Understand the relationship between the ObjectUI renderer and Shadcn UI components

---

## Conceptual Differences

### Shadcn UI Components
- 📦 **Pure UI component library**
- 🎨 Based on Radix UI + Tailwind CSS
- 💻 Requires writing React code
- 🔧 Controlled via props

### ObjectUI Renderer
- 🔄 **Schema interpreter**
- 📋 Driven by JSON configuration
- 🚀 Usable with zero code
- 🔗 Automatic data binding and validation

---

## One-to-One Mapping

| Shadcn UI | ObjectUI Renderer | Enhancements |
|-----------|------------------|-------------|
| `<Input />` | `{ type: "input" }` | ✅ Expressions, ✅ Validation, ✅ Data binding |
| `<Button />` | `{ type: "button" }` | ✅ Action mapping, ✅ Loading state |
| `<Select />` | `{ type: "select" }` | ✅ Dynamic options, ✅ Remote search |
| `<Dialog />` | `{ type: "dialog" }` | ✅ Conditional display, ✅ Form integration |
| `<Table />` | `{ type: "table" }` | ✅ Basic table rendering |
| `<Card />` | `{ type: "card" }` | ✅ Dynamic content, ✅ Action buttons |
| `<Form />` | `{ type: "form" }` | ✅ Validation engine, ✅ Submit handling |
| `<Tabs />` | `{ type: "tabs" }` | ✅ Dynamic tabs, ✅ Lazy loading |
| `<Badge />` | `{ type: "badge" }` | ✅ Status mapping, ✅ Color rules |
| `<Alert />` | `{ type: "alert" }` | ✅ Conditional display, ✅ Auto close |

---

## ObjectUI-Only Components
```
